mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_no, member_no, category, title, content, secret_yn, status, created_at, delete_yn) VALUES (board_seq.nextval, #{memberNo}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{secretYn}, '답변대기', SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT board_no AS boardNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM board WHERE delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT board_no AS boardNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM board WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT board_no AS boardNo, member_no AS memberNo, category, title, content, secret_yn AS secretYn, status, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, delete_yn AS deleteYn FROM board WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET category = #{dto.category}, title = #{dto.title}, content = #{dto.content}, secret_yn = #{dto.secretYn}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE board_no = #{boardNo}
UPDATE board SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE board_no = #{boardNo}
